title: lua: Add lua traceback to proto_tree
description:
If the lua dissector fails, don't just show the error message
in the proto_tree. Also add a "Lua Traceback" subtree and
add one text proto_item for every line in the traceback.

Example:

![luatb](/uploads/b24fa5f2a0935d2b1c1c8bfbeab1eaa4/luatb.PNG)
